class_imbalance: No reweighting or resampling (class_weight=None), so leaf probabilities stay empirical class frequencies. Imbalance is addressed in evaluation through positive-class precision/recall, macro-F1 and observation Top-1.

preprocessing.missing_values: SimpleImputer(strategy='median', add_indicator=True), fitted on training-fold rows only
preprocessing.scaling: StandardScaler fitted on training-fold rows (only models that request scaling)

label_policy: Fit on trusted labelled C2 rows only (label not null; ambiguous/unaligned observations excluded). Scores produced for all candidate rows.
metric_definitions: src/evaluation/metrics.py (candidate metrics at threshold 0.5; precision/recall *_pos = positive class, f1_macro = unweighted mean over both classes; Top-1 over trusted observations)
limitations: Probabilities are piecewise constant leaf frequencies (coarse ranking, many ties within an observation; ties resolved by lowest cand_rank).
max_depth=12 / min_samples_leaf=50 are untuned baseline limits against overfitting.
Decision threshold 0.5 is not tuned; positive-class recall depends on it.
Labels come from M1's derived reference alignment, not verified ground truth.
Candidate/observation metrics only; no HMM or route-level result.
